text:
Claire: Opened PR to reconcile Aegis-2 and Nebula-3B model card inconsistencies: limits, embed units, and a short migration example for SDKv3. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/856. Looking for bench sign-off and a small runtime compatibility note.

Ved: Quick scan : In Nebula card the `max_input_tokens` value looks like it was carried over from an earlier draft. Should be `max_input_tokens: 12288` for Dedicated, but Hosted is 4096. We should make per-deployment rows explicit.

Toni: Bench update: I ran Aegis-2 on p4d with seq=2048 batch=2. Median tokens/s=1,180; 95p=900. Uploaded CSV: https://internal-storage/redwood/bench/aegis2/2026-03-24.csv. The doc had 1,500 from a different harness; I'll attach my run to the PR.

docsbot: PR #856 created by claire  checks started (docs-lint, bench-ci, link-check).

Andre: I'll take SDK snippet. Plan: Python streaming + JS async iterator showing function-calling metadata. Will include a short migration note mapping `max_tokens` -> `max_output_tokens`. Snippet preview pushed.

Yuki: Compatibility note: Nebula-3B int8 variant triggers kernel fallback on runtime < 2.4.3 which can increase latency; recommended wording: "For runtime < 2.4.3, prefer `nebula-3b-no-int8` or upgrade the runtime. See runtime-compat table."

Ved: Good. Also suggest adding an explicit "Bench environment" subsection listing instance type, harness version, repo commit sha used for reproducibility.

Toni: CSV uploaded and bench-ci passed. I updated the doc numbers to the new median and left the previous p4d numbers in a dedicated "Historical" block.

Claire: I added the deployment table and the bench environment subsection. Andre's snippet looks good, but can you show a tiny failover example that switches to `aegis-2-lite` when `latency_policy` is triggered?

Andre: Pushed a small JS snippet with a conditional for `latency_policy` that falls back to `aegis-2-lite`. Also added a comment about token unit consistency: use "embeddings/sec" across model cards.

Yuki: LGTM. One nit: the compat sentence should call out "kernel fallback" explicitly to help infra triage perf alerts. Suggested sentence: "Note: kernel fallback on runtime < 2.4.3 may increase latency; to avoid this, use the `nebula-3b-no-int8` variant or upgrade the runtime."

Claire: Updated wording and fixed a stale link in the Nebula card. Any objections to merging before the nightly deploy? Infra wants the compat table for routing updates.

Ved: LGTM :thumbsup:

Toni: LGTM. Thanks everyone.

Claire: Merging now and will post a note in #release-war-room. Thanks!
